Name: Add item to cart
Description: Verify an item can be added to the cart from the product page

Expected Result: Item is added to the cart
The added item is listed with quantity 1

Name: Apply an expired coupon code
Description: Verify an expired coupon is rejected
Precondition: Cart contains items and an expired coupon code is available
Step Description: Enter the expired coupon code and apply it
Expected Result: An error states the coupon has expired

Name: Remove item from cart
Description: Verify an item can be removed from the cart

Expected Result: Item no longer appears in the cart
